parsed.name: ESP32-CAM 串口相机模块
parsed.description: 一种基于 ESP32 的嵌入式小型相机模块，可通过串口传输图像并进行基础成像参数设置。适合实验中的低成本实时预览、简单图像采集、装置观察与流程记录。
parsed.description_en: A compact embedded camera module based on ESP32 that transmits image data over a serial connection and supports basic imaging parameter adjustment. It is suitable for low-cost live preview, simple image capture, setup observation, and experiment documentation in laboratory environments.
